attributes.residual: POOL-LITERAL AXIS IS A CLEAN NEGATIVE FOR THIS TU (do-not-retry). The mechanical reason is a SECTION fact, not a per-function one, and it is the durable finding here: bosscam.c declares 13 `extern f32/f64 lbl_*` pseudo-globals, but 11 of them resolve to `.sdata` (0x80343Bxx) -- WRITABLE small data holding genuinely mutable globals -- and only 2 (lbl_80345C2C = 0.1f, lbl_80345C38 = 5.0) resolve to `.sdata2`, the read-only literal pool. Only the .sdata2 pair is even a legal substitution candidate; literalizing a .sdata global would be a SEMANTIC bug, not merely a match regression. Both were probed on BossCamBossCalc (real 556, insns 905/905) and BossCamPlayerCalc (real 88, 368/368) and both were NEUTRAL. Remaining sub-100% functions here (TriggerCameraActivate 89.75%, LimitCamVal2 91.19%, BossCamLimitAttn 92.10%, GetActualAvgVec 94.00%, BossCamBossCalc 94.88%, CamLimitPlayerDpos 95.00%, BossCamPlayerCalc 96.01%, TriggerCamUpdate 96.62%) are untouched and remain open on OTHER axes -- this record caps only the pool-literal axis.
